name: Skill Coach
description: Weekly per-rep skill coaching alerts, as an Attention agent-builder flow: schedule -> askAttention (pull the week's calls per rep, evaluate five selling skills, flag gaps with a call moment and a coaching exercise) -> post to a channel. The @activepieces/piece-schedule cron trigger is verified against Activepieces. Confirm the askAttention context scope for a non-conversation query (contextType 'user') and the output action against your own export. Set connections and the placeholder ids (<...>) on import.

nextAction.name: coach_reps
nextAction.displayName: Evaluate five skills per rep, flag gaps with a moment and an exercise

input.prompt: You are the Skill Coach agent. (1) Pull every team call from the last 7 days and group by rep. If a rep has fewer than 2 calls, note 'Limited data' and only flag high-confidence gaps. (2) For each rep, evaluate five skills and decide proficient (no alert) or gap (alert): Discovery Depth, Presentation Clarity, Objection Recovery, Rapport Building, Closing Technique. (3) For each gap, extract one specific call moment (call name/date, a paraphrase of what happened, and what the rep should have done instead). (4) Assign one concrete coaching exercise per gap (e.g. for Discovery Depth: role-play the 5-Whys to reach financial impact within 5 follow-ups; for Closing: end every call with a calendar invite before hanging up). (5) Send one alert per rep that has at least one gap, up to 3 gap blocks per rep. List reps with no gaps in a short 'No coaching gaps detected' summary. If no calls for any rep, output exactly: 'No calls recorded this week. Coaching alerts skipped.' and stop. Output the exact report format in skill-coach.md -> Output. Apply humanizer rules: no em dashes, no AI throat-clearing, no hype, one clear ask.

nextAction.name: post_alerts
nextAction.displayName: Post the coaching alerts to the team channel
